FL.No:.155/A/ESICH-BKN/REC/ADMN/2023-1                                                                                                       Date:-18-11-2026 
                                                                    Walk-in-interview 
The Medical Superintendent ESIC Hospital Jaisalmer Road, Bikaner invites applications for the engagements of Specialists (Full time) against the vacant posts of specialists, Senior Resident (for 01 year extendable up to 03 years) & Two (2) Senior/Junior resident against the vacant post of GDMO for 1 Year. All the doctors to be engaged are purely on contractual basis for a given period or till the regular doctors join, whichever is earlier. Number of vacancies are as under: 
• FULL TIME SPECIALISTS ON CONTRACT

•  Senior/Junior resident against the vacant post of GDMO  for 1 Year 
Posts:-02 Posts (01 ST & 01  UR) 
 
DATE & TIME OF INTERVIEW 
DATE: 27/11/2026 (Friday) 
VENUE - CONFERENCE HALL, ESIC HOSPITAL, JAISALMER ROAD BIKANER RAJASTHAN 
(Reporting Time for Documents submission: 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM (No Candidate will be considered 
for Interview who reports after 11 AM on 27/11/2026) 
155/A/ESICH-BKN/REC/ADMN/2023-1 I/4641891/2026
 
  
 
ELIGIBLITY CRITERIA- 
• ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATION - 
(a) For Senior Resident: PG Degree or diploma / DNB in concerned specialty from recognized university. Candidate should have valid registration from MCI / State Medical Council. Initial appointment will be for one year & will be extended on yearly basis maximum total 03 years subject to the requirement /& satisfactory work performance reported by concerned regular HOD / analysis work performance done by Medical Superintendent. 
(b) For specialists: PG Degree or equivalent with 03-year Post PG experience or PG Diploma with 05-year post PG 
experience in respective specialty from recognized university. A candidate should have valid registration from MCI / 
State Medical Council. 
(c) For Senior/Junior Resident against the vacant post of GDMO (1 Year): Candidate having qualifications of PG Degree or diploma / DNB will be preferred, if such candidates are not available then MBBS candidates with experience/or having good clinical knowledge in any discipline will be considered. Preference will be given to candidates who have worked in ESIC & are well verse with online Dhanwantri module. Candidate should have valid registration from MCI / State Medical Council. 
• AGE: - 
(a) For Senior Resident: Upper age limit is 45 years as on the date of interview. 
(b) For specialists: Age not exceeding 69 years as on the date of interview.  
(c) For Senior/Junior Resident (1 Year) against the vacant post of GDMO: Upper age limit is 45 years as on the 
date of interview. 
  (relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS as per rules) 
 
• RESERVATION – 
SC, ST, OBC & EWS Candidate should produce relevant certificate in the prescribed proforma as per Government of India latest instructions/guidelines. 
• EMOLUMENT – 
(a) For 01 year extendable up to 03 years Senior Residents: - as per 7th CPC level 11. 
(b) For specialists Rs 121408 /- per month Consolidated remuneration 
(c) For 1 Year Senior/Junior Resident against the vacant post of GDMO Consolidated remuneration of 1,21,048/-           
(revised from time to time as ESIC HQ instructions) per month. 
Note- Minimum 50% marks in interview is compulsory for selection. 
 
HOW TO APPLY 
The eligible candidates, along with their application filled properly in prescribed pro-forma (Annexure- A) should appear for a walk-in interview on the appointed date & time. They should also bring two recent passport size photographs along with one set of attested photocopies and originals of testimonials. If any candidate's whose original documents are deposited in a Medical College to complete Bond Period, they must produce certificate in this regard issued from Principal of concerned Medical college & No Objection Certificate (NOC) from that institution stating that, in the event of their selection in the interview and their joining duty at the ESIC Hospital, Bikaner, the concerned office/institution will have no objection to permitting them to join the post. 
 
Documents to be submitted: 
1. Two passport size Photographs. 
2. One sets of the following testimonials along with the originals for verification: 
a) Proof of Date of Birth. 
b) SSC [Matriculation Certificate or equivalent.] 
c) Certificate of Qualifications & Marks sheets. 
d) MBBS Mark sheet & Degree Certificate. 
e) PG Degree / Diploma Certificate. 
155/A/ESICH-BKN/REC/ADMN/2023-1 I/4641891/2026
 
  
 
f) Caste certificate /Category Certificate in support of SC/ST/OBC (Non-creamy layer), EWS in the prescribed proforma as per Government guidelines and self-undertaking for OBC (Non- creamy layer) status in the prescribed format. 
g) UID (Aadhaar card). 
h) PAN card 
i) Experience Certificate. 
j) MCI/RMC Registration Copy. 
k) NOC from Present Employer (if applicable). 
Any other documents, if applicable/relevant (please mention) 
Cut-off date for age, qualification etc. shall be reckoned as DATE OF INTERVIEW 
 
Note: Selected candidates have to report for duty immediately or the date mentioned in offer letter, failing which it will be presumed that they are not interested in joining and their appointment will be deemed to be considered as cancelled without any correspondence in this regard. 
 
Please Note: Corrigendum/ extension etc., if any shall be published only on our website: 
"https://www.esic.nic.in/recruitments" column. Please visit our website regularly. 
 
GENERAL INSTRUCTION TO CANDIDATES AND METHOD OF APPLICATION TO 
APPEAR IN WALK IN INTERVIEW 
1. The number of vacancies may be increased and decreased without any prior notice. 
2. For the post of Specialist engagement will be purely contractual for one year, extendable up to maximum 03 years 
after break period subject to requirement, satisfactory work or till the regular incumbents joins, whichever is earlier. 
3. The engagement of Senior Resident which will be purely contractual for one year tenure, extendable up to maximum 03 years after break period subject to requirement, satisfactory work performance report by HOD & analysis work performance done by Medical Superintendent. 
4. For the post of Senior/Junior resident against the vacant post of GDMO for 1 Year, as soon as bond JR or regular incumbents 
joins their services will be terminated with immediate effect. Last person will be terminated at first (last in first out). 
5. Selected candidates will not claim for regularization of their service in the hospital/ESIC or nor they will claim for any service 
benefit like, PF, Pension, Gratuity, medical Allowance, Seniority, and Promotion etc. 
6. Private practice of any kind will not be allowed. 
7. The posts are contractual and the contractual engagement may be terminated / discontinued by contractual specialist & Senior Resident by giving one-month prior notice is advance, if they want to resign from the post however medical superintendent reserve the right to terminate the service with immediate effect without assigning any reason. 
8. Selected candidates will have to sign agreement of Terms and Conditions on Rs 500/- non judicial stamp paper to be purchased by own prior to joining. 
9. Selected candidates for the post of Specialist and SR (for 01 year extendable up to 03 years) have to submit a security 
deposit of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees twenty-five Thousand Only) as Demand draft in favour of 'ESI Fund Account No. 1’ payable 
at Bikaner, which is refundable after successful completion of contract and production of 'No dues certificate'., Amount 
will be forfeited if left before completion of contract period i.e. minimum 01-year tenure. 
10.  Selected candidates for the post of Senior Resident/Junior Resident against the vacant post of GDMO for 1 Year have to 
submit a security deposit of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) as Demand draft in favour of 'ESI Fund 
Account No. 1' payable at Bikaner, which is refundable after successful completion of contract and production of 'No 
dues certificate'., If SR/JR want to resign, they have to give one month notice in advance otherwise there security deposit 
Rs 25000/- will be forfeited. 
11. The selected specialist must have a professional indemnity policy which Should cover the period as desired by ESIC in 
the bid. The policy is meant to cover professional liability falling on them as a result of error and omissions committed 
by them while rendering professional services. The minimum sum assured per annum should be Rs.30 lac for 
Anesthesiologists, Cardiac Surgeon, Neuro Surgeons, Plastic Surgeons etc. (2) rs.20 lakhs for General Surgeons, 
Gynecologist, Obstetrician etc. (3) for Physicians Dentists, Radiologists, Pathologists etc. It should be at least of Rs.10 
lacs. A copy of the Insurance & Premium and receipt must be submitted within 7 days from the date of engagement. 
12. No TA/DA will be admissible either for the 'Walk- in- interview' or for joining the post. 
13. The Competent Authority reserves the right to fill up all or not to fill up any post or cancel any vacancy/ interview  at any stage without assigning any reasons. 
14. The selected candidates will have to join on or before the stipulated date given in offer of appointment. 
 
 
155/A/ESICH-BKN/REC/ADMN/2023-1 I/4641891/2026
 
  
 
15. The selection is subject to the candidates providing their medical fitness Certificate issued by appropriate competent 
authority. 
16. Candidates must be registered with Medial Council of India/State Medical Council before joining the post. 
17. The candidate who is in Service should submit "No Objection Certificate" from the employer at the time of interview. 
18. Candidate seeking reservation benefits for SC/ST/OBC/EWS must ensure that they are entitled to such reservations 
as per eligibility prescribed in the Notice. They should also be in possession  of the required certificates in the prescribed format in support of their claim as stipulated in  this Notice. OBC/EWS candidates should ensure that they are in possession of valid OBC/EWS Certificate current year/ latest issued by the authority mentioned in the format. 
19. The candidates are advised to bring their application/Biodata and original certificates with one set of self-attested photocopies of the certificates. If any candidate's whose original documents are deposited in a Medical College to complete bond period, they must produce certificate in this regard issued from principal of concerned Medical College & No Objection Certificate (NOC) from that institution stating that, in the event of their selection in the interview and their joining duty at the ESIC Hospital, Bikaner, the concerned office/institution will have no objection to permitting them to join the post. 
20. All the candidates are directed to report in the office of the Medical Superintendent ESIC Hospital, Bikaner, Rajasthan as per the timing mentioned above. 
21. The decision of the selection board will be final on all aspects of selection and no further correspondence will be entertained under any circumstance. 
22. The candidates shall be governed by the relevant Rules and Regulations adopted by the ESIC in this regard. 
23. Other terms & conditions will be applicable as issued by the Competent Authority from time to time. 
24. The Specialist will be entitled for 2.5 earned leave for each month of work on pro-rata basis & Sunday off per week.No leave can be availed in advance.No encashment for accumulated leave. 
25.  Senior Resident (for 01 year extendable up to 03 years) will be entitled for 2.5 earned leave for each month of work on pro-rata basis & Sunday off per week.No leave can be availed in advance.No encashment for accumulated leave. 
26. Senior/Junior Resident against the vacant post of GDMO for 1 Year will be entitled for 1 earned leave for each month of work on pro-rata basis & Sunday/Weekly off per week. No leave can be availed in advance.No encashment for accumulated leave. 
27. The duties of the doctor will be as assigned by the Medical Superintendent. Senior/Junior Resident have to work upto 48 hrs/week They will be required to attend emergency duties & call duties as assigned by MS or his representative 
even on Sunday & Gazetted holiday. 
28. Absence from work for a period of fifteen days without proper permission of the competent authority will amount to voluntary abandonment of engagement and no further order of disengagement shall be necessary. 
29. No Hostel accommodation/quarters will be provided to the Senior Residents on contract basis. 
30. Senior resident/Junior Resident have to perform floor duty in emergency department / concerned department as per the instruction of Medical Superintendent given in the interest of beneficiaries & have to examine all kind of patients’ preliminary apart patients of own specialty. 
31. Senior/Junior Resident against the vacant post of GDMO for 1 Year are required to do duties in emergency  department / 
IPD floor duties, but their services may be utilized anywhere in hospital based on need so Senior   Resident having post 
graduate degree in General medicine / accident & emergency will be given preference if such candidates are not available then MBBS candidates with experience/or having good clinical knowledge in any discipline will be considered. Preference will be given to candidates who have worked in ESIC & are well verse with online Dhanwantri module.. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  Medical Superintendent  
    ESIC Hospital, Bikaner

दिनांक 30 अक्टूबर, 2026 को आयोदित साक्षात्कार के आधार पर आईसीएमआर-एनआईआईएच, म ंबई के 
अंतर्गत सीआरएमसीएच, न्यू चंद्रप र में वैज्ञादनक-बी (दचदकत्सा) के पि पर सीधी भती के आधार पर (दवज्ञापन सं. 
ICMR/Rectt/CRMCH/01/2026-RPCell दिनांक 03.06.2026 के अन सार) दनम्नदिखित उम्मीिवारों का चयन दकया र्या 
है :- / The following candidates have been selected for the post of Scientist -B (Medic al) at CRMCH, New 
Chandrapur under ICMR -NIIH, Mumbai on direct recruitment basis (vide Adv. No. 
ICMR/Rectt/CRMCH/01/2026-RPCell dated 03.06.2026) based on interview held on 30 October, 2026:- 
क्र.सं. / S.No. पंजीकरण सं. / Regd. No. श्रेणी / Category 
1 SCI_BM_NIIH_0626_000409 UR 
2 SCI_BM_NIIH_0626_000110 SC 
 
दनय खि का प्रस्ताव उपय गि चयदनत उम्मीिवारों को उनकी पंिीक ृ त ईमेि आईडी पर यथासमय ईमेि के माध्यम 
से भेिा िाएर्ा। / The Offer of appointment will be sent through email to the above selected candidates on their 
registered email ID in due course. 
यह चयन िस्तावेिों के सत्यापन तथा वतगमान दनयोिा से अनापदि प्रमाण पत्र (एनओसी)/कायगम खि आिेश प्राप्त 
होने के अध्यधीन है। / The Selection is subject to verification of Documents and NOC/ Relieving Order from the 
current employer. 
          
 
          (यश भारद्वाज) / (Yash Bhardwaj)
